what: D-041 made the ORIGINAL light crests (deep navy -> amber-gold -> crimson red, white foam) light's default again; #431 (spectrum) keeps them by default. The original crests over live light (v2 at 16 m) and over the re-solved spectrum, at the opacity the engine gives a crest core per zoom.

model.note: weakest APCA |Lc| over swell lighting 0/0.5/1 and whitecap off/on, wash at world opacity

engine.note: production build of the merged #431 (dev 83c1c4c0c + #431), offline synthetic backend, open sea at 12N 125W (about 2 m), 12 paired frames per zoom (exact crest-free wash under each), crest_contrast.py p99 over sea pixels

solver.tool: spectrum-apart.mjs --crest-lc N --crest-zoom 9 (original crest core at close-zoom opacity at least N APCA |Lc| off the wash at every height), with the re-solve's other rules, wide lightness and hue windows
solver.result: infeasible at N = 20 and 30 (no colour at 2.5 m), 15 and 12 (none at 2.5 m), 10 (no path at 4 m): no light wash that darkens with height keeps the original crests visible at every height; amber (about 3 m) and crimson (6 m up) are mid-lightness and a falling wash passes through them
